P1.rule: tau 0.5 and 2 s unicast delivery within 0.05 of hand E_z[1 - PER^6]

P2.rule: tau 2 s retry gain <= iid retry gain / 3 at 524, 574, 630 m

P3.rule: recovery 1 m turn unicast first failing distance <= 630 m at tau 0.5 and 2 s

P4.rule: tau 0.1 s unicast strictly between hand frozen and simulated iid at 574, 630, 691 m

P5.rule: broadcast delivery agrees with iid within the seed-level intervals at every distance

evaluation.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if P2 and P3 hold; CONTRADICTED if the recovery 1 m turn unicast first failing distance is >= 758 m at both tau 0.5 and 2 s, where never failing on the grid counts as >= 758 m (amendment A1, before the full run); MIXED otherwise

rules.cell_fails: at least 50 % of seeds fail (EXP-006 cell rule, still proposed)
rules.delivery: received over sent, all 121 tracker packets, any arrival time
rules.delivery_interval: seed-level: mean of per-seed delivery +/- 1.96 sd / sqrt(n); the pooled Wilson interval is valid only for iid fading
rules.retry_gain: unicast delivery minus broadcast delivery at the same distance and fading
rules.seed_fails: p95 error > 0.25 m or max error > 0.50 m after the 2 s settling period (EXP-006)
